nodes.name: knowledge-gaps-card.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Vitest test suite for the KnowledgeGapsCard component, covering empty state, header badges, open/resolved gap rows, occurrence badge colours, and the resolved-gaps expand/collapse toggle.

nodes.name: bot-reply-poller.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Vitest test suite for BotReplyPoller verifying initial render, polling timing with fake timers, router refresh on bot reply arrival, and network-error resilience.

nodes.name: document-threads-board.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Extensive Vitest test suite for DocumentThreadsBoard covering empty state, thread rendering, user/bot comment display, moderation controls, BotReplyPoller integration, and reply form submission.

nodes.name: markdown-content.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Vitest tests for the MarkdownContent component validating plain text rendering, markdown element conversion (bold, italic, code, lists, headings), and size-prop CSS class behaviour.

nodes.name: modal.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Vitest tests for the Modal component covering open/closed rendering, title/children display, close-button callback, backdrop overlay, and heading semantics.

nodes.name: env.client.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest tests for the clientEnv module validating default fallback values for appName, appUrl, and botName, as well as correct env-var override behaviour via vi.stubEnv.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Admin detail page for a knowledge-gap discussion thread, displaying the original unanswered query, comment history, resolve/reopen actions, and a link to capture the answer as a knowledge-base document.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Admin route that renders the AI chat interface for a specific project, guarded by requireAdmin and showing an empty initial session.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Admin page displaying document discussion threads for a specific document within a project, with full moderation privileges, guarded by requireProjectAdmin.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Admin full-text search page that searches document chunks accessible to the admin across all projects, displaying highlighted snippet results with project context.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Member route that renders the AI chat interface for a project the user has access to, verifying membership before rendering the ChatInterface component.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Member page for viewing and posting discussion threads on a specific document, with moderation capability inferred from whether the user is a project admin.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Member project overview page listing KT documents with search, quiz status badge, and links to Chat, Quiz, Bookmarks, Flashcards, and Study Mode features.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Member full-text search page for searching document chunks across all assigned projects, with highlighted snippet results and optional per-project filtering.

nodes.name: document-threads.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js Server Actions for document thread and knowledge-gap thread management: creating threads, adding replies, updating status (open/resolved), and dismissing knowledge gaps, all with role-based authorization checks.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin-only REST endpoint returning project analytics data, gated by admin role check and projectId query param validation.

nodes.name: knowledge-gap-thread-button.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component providing a button that opens a Modal for creating a knowledge-gap discussion thread, supporting single-project shortcuts and multi-project selection.

nodes.name: knowledge-gaps-card.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component rendering a card of unresolved knowledge gaps detected in the last 30 days, with dismiss, capture-to-document, and create-thread actions, plus a collapsible resolved-gaps section.

nodes.name: project-knowledge-gaps-table.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component rendering a tabular view of knowledge gap queries for a single project, with per-row actions to capture answers as documents or create discussion threads.

nodes.name: chat-interface.tsx
nodes.summary: Full-featured AI chat client component managing session state, streaming message submission, session history sidebar, response-style selection, citations-only and clarify-first modes, bookmark toggling, session renaming/deletion, and transcript download.

nodes.name: bot-reply-poller.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component that polls the bot-reply API endpoint every 2 seconds and triggers a Next.js router refresh when an AI reply becomes available for an open document thread.

nodes.name: document-threads-board.tsx
nodes.summary: Server component rendering a two-panel discussion board for a document: a form to start new threads and a list of existing threads with comments, bot-reply indicators, moderation controls, and reply forms.

nodes.name: debounced-document-search.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component providing a debounced document search bar that updates URL query params 350 ms after typing, supporting optional project-filter select and minimum-character thresholds.

nodes.name: markdown-content.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component that renders a markdown string as rich HTML using react-markdown and remark-gfm, with two size modes (sm for inline comments, base for full prose) and special styled headings for Checklist, Timeline, Risk Matrix, and Dependency Map sections.

nodes.name: modal.tsx
nodes.summary: Minimal client-side modal dialog component with a fixed backdrop overlay, title, close button, and children slot; renders nothing when closed.

nodes.name: data.ts
nodes.summary: Central server-only data access layer providing all SQL query functions for users, projects, documents, quizzes, flashcards, chat sessions, analytics, RAG observability, knowledge gaps, and system health, using the postgres tagged-template client.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Next.js unstable_cache for notification counts and import 'server-only' to prevent accidental client-side import. Implements lazy schema-migration patterns for knowledge-gap and dismissed-gaps tables.

nodes.name: env.client.ts
nodes.summary: Exposes a clientEnv object containing only NEXT_PUBLIC_ environment variables safe for browser use: appName, appUrl, and botName with sensible defaults.

nodes.name: createKnowledgeGapThreadAction
nodes.summary: Server action that creates a new knowledge-gap thread for a project after verifying moderation permissions, lazily ensuring the knowledge-gap schema columns exist.

nodes.name: createDocumentThreadAction
nodes.summary: Server action that creates a document discussion thread with an initial comment and enqueues a bot_thread_reply background job for AI-powered responses.

nodes.name: addDocumentThreadReplyAction
nodes.summary: Server action that posts a reply comment to an existing document or knowledge-gap thread, promoting it to an official answer if the user has moderation rights.

nodes.name: updateDocumentThreadStatusAction
nodes.summary: Server action that transitions a document thread between open and resolved states, requiring moderation access and revalidating all affected paths.

nodes.name: dismissKnowledgeGapAction
nodes.summary: Server action that dismisses a knowledge gap query for admins by inserting the normalised query into the dismissed_knowledge_gaps table.

nodes.name: ChatInterface
nodes.summary: Main exported React component managing the full chat UI lifecycle: message streaming, session switching, history loading, bookmarks, response style, citations/clarify modes, session rename/delete, and transcript export.

nodes.name: DocumentThreadsBoard
nodes.summary: Exported component that renders a complete discussion board for a document, including thread creation form, thread list with comments, bot-reply polling, and moderation controls.

nodes.name: BotReplyPoller
nodes.summary: Client component that polls the bot-reply endpoint at 2-second intervals and refreshes the page router when a reply arrives for a given thread.

nodes.name: DebouncedDocumentSearch
nodes.summary: Exported search component that debounces input and drives Next.js router URL updates for full-text document search with optional project-scope filtering.

nodes.name: MarkdownContent
nodes.summary: Exported component rendering markdown as styled HTML with two display modes (sm for comment-level text, base for full prose with custom heading variants).

nodes.name: KnowledgeGapsCard
nodes.summary: Exported component showing knowledge-gap queries grouped into open and resolved sections with dismiss, capture, and thread-creation actions.

nodes.name: KnowledgeGapThreadButton
nodes.summary: Exported button component that opens a Modal for raising a knowledge-gap discussion thread, supporting single or multi-project selection.

nodes.name: ProjectKnowledgeGapsTable
nodes.summary: Exported component rendering a sortable table of per-project knowledge gap queries with capture-to-document and create-thread action columns.

nodes.name: getAssignedProjects
nodes.summary: Fetches all active projects assigned to a user, aggregating document counts, quiz attempt status, new-docs flags, viewed-document counts, and open-thread counts in a single parallel query fan-out.

nodes.name: getDocumentThreads
nodes.summary: Loads all discussion threads for a document along with their comments, enriching each comment with author name, email, global role, and project role.

nodes.name: searchProjectDocumentChunks
nodes.summary: Full-text searches document chunks within a project using ts_vector when available, falling back to LIKE-based matching with highlighted snippet generation.

nodes.name: searchAccessibleDocumentChunks
nodes.summary: Searches document chunks accessible to a user (admin sees all, member sees assigned projects only), with optional project-scope filter and ts_vector/LIKE dual strategy.

nodes.name: getAdminDashboardStats
nodes.summary: Aggregates admin dashboard metrics including total users, active users, messages, documents, quiz completion rate, pending retake requests, open threads, and recent activity in a single parallel query fan-out.

nodes.name: getKnowledgeGaps
nodes.summary: Queries RAG traces for refused/refusal events in the last 30 days, aggregating by normalised query text and joining to knowledge-gap thread resolution status, while excluding dismissed gaps.

nodes.name: ensureDismissedGapsSchema
nodes.summary: Lazy idempotent schema migration that creates the dismissed_knowledge_gaps table on first use, using a module-level promise cache to avoid re-running.

nodes.name: getInteractiveStudyGuide
nodes.summary: Builds an interactive study guide from the user's latest coaching plan, enriching weak-section recommendations with relevant chunk references scored by keyword overlap.

nodes.name: getOpenThreadsForUser
nodes.summary: Returns a filtered list of document/knowledge-gap threads accessible to the user, with admin users seeing all threads and members seeing only threads from their assigned projects.
